tasks.short: Inspect plant and report mechanical problems

steps.what: Inspect biofuels plant or processing equipment regularly and judge the actual observed damage or mechanical problems under the existing inspection procedure.
outputs: Actual observations and identified problems

steps.what: Write the actual equipment condition, damage and mechanical problem observations in the maintenance inspection draft {OTHER}.
outputs: Populated inspection draft in the maintenance management system

steps.what: Prepare the actual problem notification for the responsible maintenance recipient from the inspection draft {OTHER}.
outputs: Completed problem notification and proposed recipient

steps.what: Check the completed inspection record and problem notification against the actual equipment, observed condition, urgency and intended maintenance recipient.
outputs: Checked exact record, notification and recipient

steps.what: Save the exact checked inspection record in the maintenance management system {OTHER}.
outputs: Saved actual inspection record

steps.what: Send the exact checked problem notification to the verified maintenance recipient through the maintenance management system {OTHER}.
inputs: Exact notification and recipient checked in s4
outputs: Sent actual damage or mechanical-problem report

tasks.design: Configure native equipment defaults and problem-notification fields in the maintenance management system {OTHER}. Reuse established equipment identity and actual recorded observations, keeping all new findings and urgency decisions human. Saving and reporting remain distinct actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Existing asset details and report headings are repeatedly entered in inspection and notification forms.
tasks.enabler_now: Native asset-linked forms and reusable notification fields.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising real equipment damage and its operational significance.

ambition.what: Support current plant inspection and reporting.

tasks.altitude: Inspection and safety responsibility remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Native maintenance forms can reuse asset identifiers and report fields while actual observations and urgency remain human.

assumptions: Conditional E1 active-work allocation, not measured. Gains apply only to actual repeated field entry; already configured forms yield zero.

s1 produces real observations; s2 actually writes them. Asset ID and location come from the existing asset register and are physically checked. Missing or wrong asset details are repaired manually. No complete inspection feed or generated diagnosis.

s3 drafts the real notification; s4 checks meaning and recipient after both artefacts exist. It is the ordinary final check, not added self-approval labour. Exact save and send gates are separate, both fully retained at 1%.

This is the reporting path under existing plant procedures. Immediate safety actions remain governed by those procedures and are not delayed by record preparation or counted as software savings. Maintenance staff's repair effort is unchanged and outside the saving.
research_questions: Can native fields reduce real repeated entry without masking new observations or wrong asset selection?

already_counted.description: Physical inspection, actual findings, residual report preparation, final checks, record save and send remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain asset defaults and notification routing after plant changes.

approvals.approved_version: Exact actual inspection record checked in s4
Exact problem notification, urgency and recipient checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 18 x 25% plus 8 x 20% repeated-field reduction = 6.1 gross points less 1 upkeep = 5.1; high rounded down to 5. No physical, judgment or action-tail saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the actual authorised production order and refined feedstock specification for the current batch in {OPS_SYSTEM}.
outputs: Current batch requirements and source identities

steps.what: Measure the actual refined feedstock and verify its identity and condition using the established measurement procedure.
outputs: Actual measured values, units and material identity

steps.what: Write the actual measured values, units and batch identifiers in the batch worksheet draft {SPREADSHEET}.
outputs: Populated measurement worksheet

steps.what: Calculate the specified feedstock quantities from the actual worksheet values using the authorised fixed calculation method {SPREADSHEET}.
inputs: Authorised calculation method and batch target
outputs: Completed draft quantity calculation with units

steps.what: Check the completed quantities and actual material, destination and current plant readiness for the specific authorised loading operation.
outputs: Immediate exact loading go or hold

steps.what: Load the exact checked refined feedstock through the existing authorised physical operation.
outputs: Actual loaded material or stopped operation

steps.what: Verify the actual loaded state and existing readiness requirements for the specific authorised mixing operation.
outputs: Immediate exact mixing go or hold

steps.what: Mix the checked batch using the existing authorised equipment and procedure while observing the actual operation.
outputs: Actual mixing outcome or stopped operation

steps.what: Write the actual loading and mixing outcome in the batch record {OPS_SYSTEM} and check the completed record against the measurements and observed events.
outputs: Checked final actual batch record

steps.what: Commit the exact checked actual batch record in {OPS_SYSTEM}.
outputs: Saved actual feedstock handling record

tasks.design: Configure the authorised fixed quantity calculation in the existing {SPREADSHEET}, testing native plant calculation functions first. The technician still produces and captures actual measurements and performs loading and mixing under existing controls. No generated recipe or model-operated plant control.
tasks.previous_blocker: An authorised fixed calculation is repeatedly set up manually.
tasks.enabler_now: Locked native formulas and explicit unit checks can retain the approved method.
tasks.still_hard: Actual material suitability and physical plant readiness.
tasks.human_edge: Checking the real batch and stopping on mismatches.

ambition.what: Support the current batch quantity calculation.

tasks.altitude: Operating authority and process choices are unchanged.

evidence.claim: Configured authorised formulas can reduce repeated active quantity calculation without measuring materials or controlling physical loading and mixing.

assumptions: E1 conditional allocation where repeated calculation setup exists. If calculations already run natively, saving is zero; existing automatic mixing or control runtime earns no human saving.

Process staff supply the authorised method and order. The technician produces actual quantity, unit, material and batch fields in s2 and captures them in s3; missing or inconsistent inputs remain manual and block operation as needed.

s5 and s7 are ordinary immediate safe-work decisions on specific fully defined operations, not new approval bureaucracy. Changed material or plant state requires recheck. No operational parameters or substitute process instructions are supplied.

The s9 actual outcome record and check occur after the work, not from planned completion. Its exact version gates the fully retained commit. Initial measurements stay fully counted; no new free data feed or transferred labour.
research_questions: Can native calculations reproduce authorised historical examples including wrong-unit and missing-value cases?

already_counted.description: Actual order review, measurement/capture, residual calculation, readiness, physical handling and actual records remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain approved formula versions and check unit mappings after changes.

approvals.approved_version: Exact material, quantity, destination and immediate loading scope checked in s5
Exact loaded batch and immediate mixing scope checked in s7
Exact actual completed batch record checked in s9

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 10 x 50% active calculation reduction = 5 gross points less 1 upkeep. Physical work, actual capture, controls and records have no saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Inspect the actual stored biofuels products and secondary by-products and their storage locations during the required field rounds.
outputs: Actual observed storage conditions

steps.what: Monitor the actual storage instrumentation and process-control indications for the identified stored material using the plant control system {OTHER}.
outputs: Inspected current readings and any missing or suspect signals

steps.what: Find prior storage readings and actual stock-status entries in the plant historian {OTHER} and {OPS_SYSTEM} to compare the current observations.
outputs: Relevant dated history and recorded status

steps.what: Judge the actual storage condition and any exception, continuing monitoring until actual reuse or transfer is verified rather than assuming it from a scheduled movement.
inputs: Actual verified movement evidence when available
outputs: Human monitoring judgment and actual continued or ended storage scope

steps.what: Write and check the actual monitoring observations and storage-status evidence in the plant operations log {OTHER}.
outputs: Checked final monitoring-log entry

steps.what: Prepare and check any actual required storage-condition notification, including its meaning, urgency and responsible recipient, in the operations log system {OTHER}.
outputs: Checked exact required notification and recipient

steps.what: Save the exact checked actual monitoring entry in the operations log system {OTHER}.
outputs: Saved actual storage monitoring record

steps.what: Send the exact checked required storage-condition notification to the verified responsible recipient through the operations log system {OTHER}.
inputs: Exact notification and recipient checked in s6
outputs: Sent actual condition notification

tasks.design: Configure native material/location filters for historical readings and status in the plant historian {OTHER} and {OPS_SYSTEM}. Reduce finding prior information only. Retain current instrument monitoring, physical rounds, condition judgment, actual logs and required notifications.
tasks.previous_blocker: History and stock status are repeatedly found through separate tag and location searches.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked material and location views.
tasks.still_hard: Suspect signals, real condition changes and confirming the actual end of storage responsibility.
tasks.human_edge: Combining field evidence with instrument indications and taking responsible action.

ambition.what: Support existing monitoring until actual reuse or transfer.

evidence.claim: Native historian and stock-status views can reduce historical lookup without automating physical monitoring or proving a material transfer.

assumptions: E1 unmeasured allocation across a monitoring cycle including actual required notifications, not an alert invented for every round. No saving on log or notification work; cycles without a notification retain their real task boundary and gain only from any actual history lookup.

s1 produces actual field observations; s2 reads actual instrumentation. Existing historian records are system-produced and actual stock-status records are produced by the responsible movement workflow. Missing or conflicting identifiers require manual confirmation; no clean current-status feed is assumed.

Monitoring continues until actual reuse/transfer evidence is checked in s4. Executing a transfer, shipment or production reuse is a separate physical workflow with no claimed saving; a planned movement does not close monitoring.

s5 and s6 are ordinary completed-artefact checks, supplying separate exact save and send gates without added self-approval. Edits invalidate checks. Both action tails are fully retained and immediate safety actions are not delayed for logging.
unknowns: Actual evidence for completed stock movements
research_questions: Can the view show missing signals and conflicting stock status without implying completion?

already_counted.description: All field rounds, current monitoring, residual history review, judgment, actual logs, notifications and actions remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain location/tag links and inspect stale stock-status mismatches.

approvals.approved_version: Exact actual monitoring-log entry checked in s5
Exact required condition notification and recipient checked in s6

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 10 x 40% historical retrieval reduction = 4 gross points less 1 upkeep. No current monitoring, physical movement, actual record or action-tail saving.

steps.what: Inspect the actual biofuels additives and obtain the required representative material under the existing quality procedure.
outputs: Actual identified material and observed condition

steps.what: Perform the technician's actual required quality measurements or checks using the established authorised method.
outputs: Actual quality measurements and exceptions

steps.what: Write the actual measured values, units and lot identifiers into the quality assessment draft {OTHER}.
outputs: Populated quality record in the laboratory information system

steps.what: Find the applicable quality criteria and previous actual additive-lot results in the laboratory information system {OTHER}.
outputs: Relevant actual criteria and comparable results

steps.what: Assess the quality of biofuels additives for reprocessing from the actual results and criteria, retaining uncertainty and escalating outside the technician's authority.
outputs: Human quality assessment or held question

steps.what: Write the actual quality assessment and limitations in the laboratory information system {OTHER} and check the completed record against the material, results and criteria.
outputs: Checked final additive quality record

steps.what: Commit the exact checked quality assessment record in the laboratory information system {OTHER}.
outputs: Saved actual quality assessment

tasks.design: Configure native additive and lot filters in the laboratory information system {OTHER}. Shorten locating criteria and previous comparable results, keeping actual material checks, measurement capture and quality judgment human. No model recommends a reprocessing recipe or releases material.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual criteria and comparable lot results require repeated manual navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native material/lot queries and current-criteria filters.
tasks.still_hard: Unrepresentative samples, uncertain results and actual suitability.
tasks.human_edge: Judging whether the evidence supports the assessment and holding uncertain material.

ambition.what: Support the existing additive quality assessment.

tasks.altitude: Quality responsibility and release rights are unchanged.

evidence.claim: Native material and lot filters can reduce actual quality-record lookup without producing measurements or deciding suitability.

assumptions: E1 unmeasured allocation for technician-performed checks, not free laboratory work moved from another role. If separate laboratory staff perform a check, retain their actual labour outside this role and price this technician's actual workflow before claiming savings.

s1 and s2 produce actual material and results, and s3 captures value, unit, lot and method context. Current authorised criteria come from existing quality staff records. Missing sources or incompatible methods are resolved manually, not treated as comparable.
s6 is ordinary actual-assessment writing and completed-record checking, supplying the requested exact-version commit gate without added self-approval labour. Save time remains fully retained.
Recording an assessment is not a reprocessing control action, material release or external certificate. Those separate actions and any required independent sign-off have no saving claimed here.
research_questions: Can native filters preserve lot identity, method version and units when showing comparable results?

already_counted.description: Actual material checks, measurements, capture, residual lookup, human assessment, final record and commit remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain current criteria links and lot/method filter mappings.

approvals.approved_version: Exact actual additive-quality record checked in s6

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 10 x 40% actual source retrieval reduction = 4 gross points less 1 upkeep. No physical, measurement, quality-decision or record-tail saving.

role.altitude: Plant operation, physical observation and quality judgment remain with the technician.
role.ambitious_version: A technician who reduces repeated entry and lookup while retaining direct plant awareness, physical work and accountable decisions.
